title: Elite Mission
wikitext:
[[Elite Mission]]s are difficult [[mission]]s designed for high level and well organized [[Party|parties]]. They tend to take a long time to complete and are usually filled with high-level foes. They play much like typical [[campaign]] missions, but they are not required to complete the campaign nor to progress the [[Protector]] titles. As with any mission, there are no [[Resurrection Shrine]]s and you will be returned to the last visited [[outpost]] or lobby should the party [[wipe]]. Most elite missions have [[chest]]s that [[drop]] high quality and often uniquely [[skin]]ned items and have bosses that drop [[unique item]]s unavailable elsewhere. Most elite missions have a corresponding [["Honor"]] statue for the [[Hall of Monuments]].

== Listing ==
=== Core ===
Although not officially called elite missions, [[the Underworld]] and [[the Fissure of Woe]] are two very difficult areas in the game. These areas are only for [[Ascension|ascended]] ([[Prophecies]]) characters, [[Weh no Su]] ([[Factions]]) characters or [[Nightfall]] characters who have completed the [[Hunted!]] quest. These areas become accessible by means of kneeling at certain statues of the gods or using a [[Passage Scroll]].
* The Underworld access is bought from the [[Voice of Grenth]], who can be summoned by using the ''/kneel'' [[emote]] in front of the [[Statue of Grenth]] in [[Temple of the Ages]] or [[Lornar's Pass]] (Prophecies), [[Zin Ku Corridor]] (Factions), or [[Chantry of Secrets]] (Nightfall). A [[Passage Scroll to the Underworld]] can be used instead.
* The Fissure of Woe access is bought from the [[Champion of Balthazar]], who can be summoned by using the ''/kneel'' emote in front of the [[Statue of Balthazar]] in Temple of the Ages (Prophecies), Zin Ku Corridor (Factions) or Chantry of Secrets (Nightfall). A [[Passage Scroll to the Fissure of Woe]] can be used instead.

=== Prophecies ===
While there are no official elite missions in the Prophecies campaign, there are two areas that behave similarly to them:
* [[Sorrow's Furnace]] is located north of the [[Deldrimor Warcamp]] in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]. Players must first pass through [[Grenth's Footprint]] to gain access. All bosses in this area have a possibility to drop unique items.
* [[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings|Tomb of the Primeval Kings]], located north of [[The Dragon's Lair (outpost)|The Dragon's Lair]], contains four zones and is filled with foes found in [[The Underworld]]. Creatures here have a small chance to drop a rare [[Glob of Ectoplasm]] and the 3 bosses ([[The Darkness (boss)|The Darkness]]es) in the final zone are guaranteed to drop unique items.

=== Factions ===
There are two elite missions in the Factions campaign.
* [[The Deep]] is accessed through [[Eurayle]] or a [[Passage Scroll to the Deep]] (see [[The Deep (outpost)]] for more information).
* [[Urgoz's Warren]] is accessed through [[Vash]] or a [[Passage Scroll to Urgoz's Warren]] (see [[Urgoz's Warren (outpost)]] for more information).

=== Nightfall ===
There is only one elite mission in the Nightfall campaign.
* [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]] is found in the [[Domain of Anguish]]. To reach the Domain, players must first complete the Nightfall campaign, then return to the [[Chantry of Secrets]]. To gain access to the Elite Mission, players must then complete the first four parts of the quest [[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)|Mallyx the Unyielding]].

=== Eye of the North ===

* There are no missions officially labeled elite in [[Eye of the North]]; however, [[Slavers' Exile]] is a [[dungeon]] with a reward chest that spawns upon completing the ''Difficulty: Elite'' [[quest]], [[The Last Hierophant]]. Before confronting the final foe, [[Duncan the Black]], players must complete four other areas that have portals from within Slaver's Exile.
